verdict.rationale: Fathom documents in-product AI outputs from meeting data: instant AI summaries, AI-generated action items, a Deal View summarizing insights, AI coaching scorecards and a conversational meeting assistant. All of this rests on one-line pricing and marketing claims, and proactive 'suggestions' are only implied through action items and scorecards. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how insights and suggestions are generated and surfaced, explicit evidence of recommendation-style suggestions beyond action items, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Advanced call summaries, including custom summaries
